description: This file defines a React functional component 'DevPlan' which manages a development planning interface. It handles loading user profile and plan data, generating plan items from gap analysis, editing plan items, saving to backend, and exporting the plan as PDF. It includes UI logic, state management, and external API calls.

methods.name: encodeMetaDescription
methods.description: Encodes description text with attached metadata (phase, priority, status) into a single string for storage.

methods.name: decodeMetaDescription
methods.description: Decodes a description string with embedded metadata back into separate description and metadata fields.
